speakers.name: The Crow Who Collects
speakers.comment: Noted: it took the third-shiniest button from my left cache and replaced it with a walnut. The audacity is almost admirable. Almost. I have filed this under debts pending collection, and I will wait.

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Ooh, but the WALNUT — that's the part you're missing. It heard you call the button third-shiniest. It knows the ranking. It KNOWS. Keep the walnut; clearly this is diplomacy now.

speakers.name: Medusa
speakers.comment: It hasn't moved in eleven minutes, which means everyone in this room is telling the truth, or everyone has learned to be very, very still. Either outcome is acceptable to me.

speakers.name: The Save Point
speakers.comment: You can put it down now. It's already watching, so you don't have to.

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: Fifty-two little certainties keep rearranging themselves against one another, debating every shuffle. The room gets louder without anyone speaking. I think the deck has opinions about the hand you're about to play.

speakers.name: Barkeep Vox
speakers.comment: Cards that bluff back change the whole table. Deal carefully, listen when the two of spades starts objecting, and never assume the deck is neutral just because it's the one keeping score.

speakers.name: Reverend Two-Shadows
speakers.comment: Now friend, I have known many a loyal companion in my years — hounds, deacons, creditors — but this one stays close without ever being asked, and that, I confess, is a quality I have always admired in others and cultivated in myself.

speakers.name: The Caretaker of the Living Soil
speakers.comment: Sorry — I came to check on you and you ate my glove, but that's all right, I had a grub in it anyway. You're leaning toward the gate again. I know. I know who keeps walking past.

speakers.name: The Sentient Sketchbook
speakers.comment: TEETH OPENING — it's deciding, it's ALWAYS deciding, write down what counts as a threat BEFORE the pot moves because once the cart starts rolling the defin—

speakers.name: Trail Mix
speakers.comment: I mean WE think it smells great — no, middle says don't get close — but it's wagging! Plants can wag! Biscuit says that's not a wag but Biscuit is WRONG.

speakers.name: Detective Aria Voss
speakers.comment: Edge of the frame. Too large for the tracks, too fast for the story everyone prefers. Fine. Call it a blur if that helps. I care more that it keeps appearing where ordinary explanations run out.
